name: MediConfusion v2 — MC Set Accuracy
protocol: MediConfusion v2 fixed 176-pair multiple-choice protocol; set accuracy only. Free-form, prefix, confusion, and individual-answer metrics are excluded.

explanation.en: A pair is correct only when both binary answers are correct; chance pair accuracy is 25%.
explanation.zh: 只有一组中的两个二元答案都正确，该组才计分；随机组准确率为 25%。

summary.en: MediConfusion tests whether multimodal models distinguish deliberately confusing pairs of medical images.
summary.zh: MediConfusion 测试多模态模型能否区分刻意构造的易混淆医学影像对。

task_format.en: The model answers the same binary question on both images in each of 176 pairs with opposite correct answers.
task_format.zh: 模型对 176 组影像中的两张图回答同一道二选一问题，而两张图的正确答案相反。
